## README.md
# Historic Tropical Cyclone Tracks — NOAA IBTrACS v04r01

Global tropical-cyclone best-track data from NOAA NCEI's **International Best Track
Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS)**, version **v04r01** — the World Data Center
merge of every Regional Specialized Meteorological Center / agency best-track dataset into
one global record. Seasons **1842–present**, all seven ocean basins. This is the
analysis-ready, continuously-updated source behind popular "historic hurricane tracks"
visualizations (e.g. NASA Earth Observatory).

Two representations of the same storms, joinable on **`SID`** (the IBTrACS storm id):

| Layer | Geometry | Features | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Storm Fixes** (`points`) | Point | 725,141 fixes / 13,558 storms | analytical layer; one point per 6-hourly observation with intensity |
| **Track Segments** (`lines`) | LineString | 711,583 segments / 13,478 storms | intensity-styled track maps; one line per consecutive fix pair |

Each layer is published as **GeoParquet** (analysis), **PMTiles** (web maps), and **H3
hex** (resolution 8, spatial joins). Points were hexed one-cell-per-point; lines were hexed
by buffering each segment by the H3 cell circumradius before polyfill.

- **License:** public domain (NOAA / WMO Resolution 40, full and open access).
- **Source:** https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/international-best-track-archive
- **Citation:** Gahtan, J., K. R. Knapp, C. J. Schreck, H. J. Diamond, J. P. Kossin, and
  M. C. Kruk, 2024: *International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS)
  Project, Version 4r01*. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information.
  doi:[10.25921/82ty-9e16](https://doi.org/10.25921/82ty-9e16).

## Key attributes

`SID` (storm id — the per-storm dedup key), `SEASON`, `NAME`, `BASIN`, `ISO_TIME`,
`NATURE`, `LAT`/`LON`, `WMO_WIND`/`WMO_PRES` (WMO-agency intensity), `USA_WIND`/`USA_PRES`
(US-agency, 1-minute), and **`USA_SSHS`** (Saffir–Simpson category, −5…5 — the primary
column for intensity styling). Wind/pressure are **instantaneous per-fix** values — never
sum them; for lifetime peak intensity use `MAX(USA_WIND)` grouped by `SID`. See the STAC
collections for full column definitions.

## MapLibre GL JS (PMTiles)

The MapLibre `source-layer` is the **last path segment of the dataset** — `points` or
`lines` (not the shapefile layer name).

```js
import { Protocol } from "pmtiles";
maplibregl.addProtocol("pmtiles", new Protocol().tile);

const map = new maplibregl.Map({
  container: "map",
  style: "https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json",
  center: [-60, 25], zoom: 3,
});

map.on("load", () => {
  // Track segments, coloured by Saffir–Simpson category (USA_SSHS)
  map.addSource("ibtracs-lines", {
    type: "vector",
    url: "pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-storms/ibtracs-v04r01/lines.pmtiles",
  });
  map.addLayer({
    id: "tracks",
    type: "line",
    source: "ibtracs-lines",
    "source-layer": "lines",          // <-- last segment of --dataset
    paint: {
      "line-width": 1.2,
      "line-color": [
        "interpolate", ["linear"], ["get", "USA_SSHS"],
        -1, "#9ecae1",   0, "#ffffb2",   1, "#fed976",
         2, "#feb24c",   3, "#fd8d3c",   4, "#f03b20",  5, "#bd0026"
      ],
    },
  });

  // Storm fixes as points
  map.addSource("ibtracs-points", {
    type: "vector",
    url: "pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-storms/ibtracs-v04r01/points.pmtiles",
  });
  map.addLayer({
    id: "fixes", type: "circle", source: "ibtracs-points",
    "source-layer": "points",         // <-- last segment of --dataset
    paint: { "circle-radius": 2, "circle-color": "#333" },
  });
});
```

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;

-- Lifetime peak intensity for the 20 strongest storms since 2000
SELECT SID, any_value(NAME) AS name, any_value(SEASON) AS season,
       MAX(USA_WIND) AS peak_wind_kt, MAX(USA_SSHS) AS peak_category
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-storms/ibtracs-v04r01/points.parquet')
WHERE SEASON >= 2000
GROUP BY SID
ORDER BY peak_wind_kt DESC
LIMIT 20;

-- Count distinct storms (NOT rows — many fixes share one SID)
SELECT BASIN, COUNT(DISTINCT SID) AS n_storms
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-storms/ibtracs-v04r01/points.parquet')
GROUP BY BASIN ORDER BY n_storms DESC;
```

### H3 hex (spatial joins at resolution 8)

```sql
-- Storms passing through each H3 res-8 cell (dedup by SID; join to other h8 datasets)
SELECT h8, COUNT(DISTINCT SID) AS n_storms
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-storms/ibtracs-v04r01/points/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
GROUP BY h8;
```

Wind/pressure/category on the hex are repeated per (observation, cell) and are
instantaneous — **never `SUM`** them; dedup by `SID` for per-storm statistics, `_cng_fid`
for per-observation. The `LON` attribute occasionally retains an agency's native 0–360
convention (values up to ~267); prefer the geometry for mapping.
